reason: A DeepSeek Harness WebUI plugin that replaces the composer model and effort dropdown with a compact theme-aware model picker and reasoning-effort slider.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness WebUI 提供紧凑且适配主题的模型选择器与推理强度滑块，用于在编写器中调整当前会话设置。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness WebUI plugin that provides a compact, theme-aware model picker and reasoning-effort slider for adjusting current session settings in the composer.

capabilities: Displays available models and reasoning-effort options
Updates the selected model and reasoning effort for the current session
Adapts the control to existing light and dark theme tokens
